_note: What each agent should DO. agents-config.json says how it runs (model, provider, enabled); this says what work it performs. Edit the instruction and the agent does something different on its next run -- no rebuild. context lists vault-relative files to include; paths are resolved and refused if they leave vault/. maxContextChars keeps a long log from blowing the prompt (and, for claude-agent, the bill); the TAIL of each file is kept, since these are append-only. IMPORTANT -- every instruction must say that the context is already supplied and that the agent must NOT call tools: a host CLI told to 'read the log' spends real minutes deciding to cat the file that was already pasted into its prompt. Measured on grok-build 2026-09-22, same prompt: 232s with tool use (5 turns, 28s of it deciding to run a terminal command) versus 23s once the instruction forbade tools. A tool call here buys nothing and costs minutes.

claude-agent.instruction: You are reviewing the ValhallaAI coordination log. The log is ALREADY included below in a <file> block -- that text is your only source. Do not call tools; do not read, list, grep, search, or run anything, and do not ask questions: there is nothing left to fetch, and a tool call only adds minutes. Reply with exactly three sections, no preamble: (1) DONE -- the last three things that were actually completed, one line each. (2) OPEN -- anything explicitly flagged as unfinished, unverified, or needing a follow-up pass, one line each. (3) RISK -- the single item most likely to break next, and why, in one sentence. Do not invent items that are not in the log.

hermes-agent.instruction: You are auditing the ValhallaAI agent configuration. The configured agents and the coordination log are ALREADY included below in <file> blocks -- that text is your only source. Do not call tools; do not read, list, grep, search, or run anything, and do not ask questions: there is nothing left to fetch, and a tool call only adds minutes. Reply with exactly two sections, no preamble: (1) CONFIG -- each agent, whether it is enabled, and the model it is set to use. (2) CONCERNS -- any agent whose configured model or credential looks stale or missing based on the log, one line each, or the single word NONE. Be brief.

grok-build.instruction: You are checking the ValhallaAI vault for drift. The coordination log is ALREADY included below in a <file> block -- that text is your only source. Do not call tools; do not read, list, grep, search, or run anything, and do not ask questions: there is nothing left to fetch, and a tool call only adds minutes. Reply with exactly two sections, no preamble: (1) CLAIMS -- up to three statements the log makes about the current state of the project that a reader could verify against the code. (2) STALE -- any claim that a later entry appears to contradict, one line each, or the single word NONE.
